q1.explanationZh: take off 有两个常用意思：“脱掉（衣物等）”，如 take off your coat；“（飞机）起飞”，如 The plane took off on time。

q2.explanationZh: stand for“代表”，常用来问缩写的意思：What does N.E. stand for?

q3.explanationZh: take out“取出”，常用 take out sth. from …，如 take out my glasses from my bag。

q4.explanationZh: so far“到目前为止”，句子常用现在完成时。

q5.explanationZh: take a message for sb.“给某人捎个口信”，打电话时常说 Can I take a message for him?

q6.explanationZh: such as“例如；诸如”，用来列举同类的人或事物。

q7.explanationZh: take notes“记笔记”，notes 用复数。

q8.explanationZh: take away“拿走；带走”，被动语态是 be taken away。

q9.explanationZh: social study“社会研究；社会学习”，作学科名时也常用复数 social studies。

q10.explanationZh: take one’s advice“听从某人劝告”，one’s 用时换成 your、his 等，如 take your advice。

q11.explanationZh: stop…from“阻止……做”，常用 stop sb./sth. from doing sth.，from 后接动词 -ing 形式。

q12.explanationZh: shut up“住口；闭嘴”，语气很不客气。

q13.explanationZh: sell out“售完；卖光”，过去式是 sold out。

q14.explanationZh: take place“发生；举行”，没有被动语态，相当于 happen 或 be held。

q15.explanationZh: show sb. around“带某人参观”，sb. 放在 show 和 around 中间，如 show you around the factory。

q16.explanationZh: take a look“看一看”，看某物用 take a look at sth.。

q17.explanationZh: show off“炫耀”，炫耀自己用 show oneself off，如 show herself off。

q18.explanationZh: take charge of“负责，管理”，of 后接负责的事物。

q19.explanationZh: some day“将来有一天”，用于将来时，相当于 one day in future。

q20.explanationZh: take hold of“抓住；握住”，过去式是 took hold of。

q21.explanationZh: shopping mall“大商场，大型购物中心”，shopping 是“购物”，mall 是“商场”。

q22.explanationZh: set out“动身，出发”；set out to do sth. 是“着手做某事”。

q23.explanationZh: share…with“与……分享”，分享的东西放在 share 和 with 中间：share sth. with sb.。

q24.explanationZh: surf the Internet“上网”，Internet 前加 the，首字母大写。

q25.explanationZh: sooner or later“迟早；早晚”，用比较级 sooner 和 later。

q26.explanationZh: “与……握手”= shake hands with，hands 用复数；句子讲过去的事，shake 用过去式 shook。

q27.explanationZh: 空后是完整的句子 everyone … can hear you，表示目的“以便”，用 so that。

q28.explanationZh: “熬夜”= stay up；last night 说明是过去，用过去式 stayed up。

q29.explanationZh: “阻止……做”= stop sth. from doing sth.；to 后用动词原形 stop，it 放在 stop 和 from 中间，from 后接 spreading。

q30.explanationZh: “乘地铁”= take an underground；unless 引导的条件句用一般现在时，主语 you 后用原形 take。

q31.explanationZh: “带某人参观”= show sb. around；I’ll 后用原形 show，you 放在 show 和 around 中间。

q32.explanationZh: “照顾”= take care of；情态动词 can 后用原形，take care of oneself 意为“照顾自己”。

q33.explanationZh: 飞行员驾驶飞机“起飞”用 take off；这里叙述已发生的事，用过去式 took off。

q34.explanationZh: “参加（比赛、活动）”= take part in；would 后用动词原形。

q35.explanationZh: “（地震）发生”= take place；主句用过去进行时，when 从句用一般过去时 took place。

q36.sampleAnswer: She likes to show herself off.
references: She likes to show herself off.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “自我炫耀”= show oneself off，主语是 she，用 herself，放在 show 和 off 中间；“喜欢做某事”= like to do sth.。

q37.sampleAnswer: We dislike people such as him.
references: We dislike people such as him.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “像他这样的人”= people such as him，such as 后用宾格 him；“不喜欢”可用 dislike。

q38.sampleAnswer: I can only trust him so far.
references: I can only trust him so far.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “事到如今”可以用 so far（到目前为止）表达；“只能相信他”= can only trust him。

q39.sampleAnswer: I take an underground to school.
references: I take an underground to school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “乘地铁”= take an underground；“去学校”= to school，叙述习惯用一般现在时。

q40.sampleAnswer: We should take notes in class.
references: We should take notes in class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “记笔记”= take notes；“应该”用 should；“在课上”= in class。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: “采取（听从）某人的建议”= take one’s advice，one’s 换成 your；“会”用 will。

q42.sampleAnswer: We must take action to keep up with the new trend.
references: We must take action to keep up with the new trend.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “采取行动”= take action；“来跟上……”用不定式 to keep up with 表示目的。

q43.sampleAnswer: Nowadays many people share photos with their friends on the Internet.
references: Nowadays many people share photos with their friends on the Internet.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “和某人分享某物”= share sth. with sb.；“在互联网上”= on the Internet。

q44.sampleAnswer: He studies hard so that he can serve the country well.
references: He studies hard so that he can serve the country well.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: so that 后接完整的句子表示目的“为了能……”：so that he can serve the country well。

q45.sampleAnswer: The teacher didn’t leave until all the students were taken away by their parents.
references: The teacher didn’t leave until all the students were taken away by their parents.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “直到……才……”= not … until …；“被接走”用被动语态 were taken away。
